title: SOS OriginSequenceTracker LRU eviction enables stale-but-unseen replay (Sybil)
description: Pre-existing, found by kimi-k3 codereview pass 2 of 3dpc.3 (NOT a regression from that bead; unchanged by cef9467ff3). python/src/lichen/coap/sos_origin.py:173-181 - OriginSequenceTracker caps at 256 origins with LRU eviction. A Sybil attacker can mint 256 valid keypairs (cheap; each is a fresh per-source rate-limit bucket), evict a victim's last_seen entry, then replay an old captured SOS that passes the 'unseen' gate at emergency.py:271-281 - reopening the exact stale-but-unseen replay the tracker was built to close. Same cost before and after the 3dpc.3 migration; the _request_times/_period_start dicts (emergency.py:104-106) are likewise unbounded per-source. Options: bound by (origin AddrForKey) with no eviction of non-expired floors (fail-closed like tunnel-auth), or tie eviction to a verified-expiry horizon.
